items.title: Slawson and McConnell — two of the hardest-playing Pacers — helped them to a 35-29 lead after 1 in Philly.
items.author: Scott Agness
items.body_excerpt:
Slawson and McConnell — two of the hardest-playing Pacers — helped them to a 35-29 lead after 1 in Philly.

Slawson had one sequence where he blocked a shot at one end, and got a rebound put-back at the other — racing in from the 3pt line untouched.

Pacers shot 62%, but 5TOs
